# Harnessie

A brain-agnostic multi-agent harness. The harness structure carries the quality floor; the model carries the ceiling.

## Release state

Source version: Harnessie 1.3.0. Published core remains 1.2.0 until release propagation completes. Version 1.3.0 adds offline observation of existing run journals with cited JSON/Markdown and no model calls. It accepts raw verification criteria or v1 evidence bundles and provides structured required-claim verdicts under the fail-closed 0/1/2 verifier exit cont
